hero.title: One system. The right structure for each product.
hero.subtitle: Explore Whitehorse's reference pack ladder for samples, HORECA, retail/private label and industrial export. Every value shown is provisional; the final pack is engineered to your product, channel and destination market.

channels.title: Start with how the buyer will use the pack.
channels.subtitle: Product physics and buyer use determine the structure. The structure then determines the barrier, closure, dimensions and graphic system.

structures.title: 27 master structures, built around product physics.
structures.subtitle: Dimensions and fill weights below are design references from the current Packaging Architecture. They help frame the brief; they are not production dielines or supplier commitments.

reference.label: General packaging specification.
reference.body: Final dimensions, fill tolerance, film or board, barrier values, seal width, closure, valve position, printable area and case cube are confirmed with the selected supplier or co-packer after machinery, shipping and destination-label requirements are known.

principles.title: Premium design begins with product protection.

items.title: Valve logic
items.body: Roasted coffee in a sealed pack needs a one-way degassing valve. Green coffee never does. Instant coffee and powders stay dust-tight with no valve.

items.title: Product visibility
items.body: A restrained window may be used for selected whole dry products after film and shelf-life validation. Powders and freeze-dried products remain opaque by default.

items.title: Single serve
items.body: Drip coffee, pure soluble coffee and premix use different structures and fill ranges. They are never collapsed into one generic sachet.

items.title: Liquid process
items.body: Chilled, hot-fill and aseptic formats are different systems. The vessel follows the approved fill process before any ambient-stability claim is made.

items.title: Industrial expression
items.body: Premium industrial packs rely on disciplined typography, lot identity and traceability—not decorative luxury finishing.

custom.title: Need another fill weight, channel, artwork system or pack structure?
custom.body: Tell us the product, format, application, destination market, volume, shelf-life target and brand model. Whitehorse will develop or source the suitable option with the selected supplier or co-packer and confirm feasibility before artwork.

privacyBody: What we collect: when you use our contact or quote-request forms, we collect the details you enter (such as your name, company, email, phone, destination and request details) and basic context such as the page you submitted from, your site language and any campaign (UTM) parameters in the link you followed.

How we use it: only to respond to your inquiry, prepare quotations and follow up on the commercial conversation you started. We do not sell your data. Submissions are delivered to our team by email and processed by our website hosting and email providers.
Your choices: to access, correct or delete your data, email {email}. Data controller: {legalName}, business registration no. {taxCode}, Hanoi, Vietnam.
termsBody: Website content, including product descriptions and specifications, is indicative and for information only. It is not an offer to sell and does not indicate that a product is in stock or export-ready.

Commercial terms — price, specification, quantity, payment, Incoterm, delivery, inspection and claims — are set out in each written quotation and sales contract, which take precedence over anything on this website.
